## Historical audit: H0094

**Scope.** This is a student coding trace, not a Scene task. Only chunk 1 of 2 is visible. Citations below refer to the original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane2/codex_parallel_08_lane2_I_r1/infer_logs/ink-grid-box-layout/turn_1/trajs.json` unless labeled inventory metadata.

| Question | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The task name and student’s work suggest adding grid layout to Ink’s `Box`; the original task request is not visible, so its complete requirements are unknown. The pre-change style supported only flex/none, and grid rendered an empty string in the student’s reproduction (H0094, main_agent events 4, 21–22). |
| Autonomous exploration | The student inspected Git references, Yoga style application, DOM, reconciler, rendering and measurement paths. The initial `main` lookup failed; `master` pointed to the starting commit and the student created `grid-layout` from it (events 1–6, 8–20, 33–34). This shows exploration, not whether it was independent of unseen teacher input. |
| Actual changes | Successful edits added grid style properties and mapped grid to Yoga flex rather than hidden (events 35–38). A new `grid-layout.ts` parses tracks and placements, sizes tracks, positions children, and repeats Yoga layout passes (events 39–40). Successful edits connected it to string and live rendering (events 41–48). A subsequent track-growth edit was requested at event 49; its result is not visible. |
| Validation and outcome | The visible reproduction before the patch returned `""` (events 21–22). The top-level result **reports** a successful build, 42 focused tests, two lint warnings, and commit `4fab2dc`; the underlying test output is not visible here (top_level_metadata, characters [0,2137)). Inventory metadata classifies the formal result as **partial correctness, not solved**: 24/25 fail-to-pass and 49/49 pass-to-pass. The failed case and cause are not provided. The patch is not empty: the inventory reports 11,504 bytes and visible edits confirm changes. Completion of the agent turn is not formal task success. |
| Teacher | Top-level metadata records one teacher check and about 20 seconds of teacher wait, but this chunk contains no delivered teacher text or evidence of adoption (top_level_metadata, [0,2137)). Linked hints establish availability only; the after-round review was not input to this round (inventory metadata). Receipt, diagnosis and influence remain unknown. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** A transferable observation is that tracing layout from style mapping through computation and rendering enabled a concrete failing reproduction and targeted integration points. Task-specific choices include Yoga-backed absolute positioning and repeated layout passes; their general correctness is not established. Whether the remaining formal failure involves track sizing, placement, updates, or another requirement is unresolved. Chunk 2 and the underlying evaluation details are not visible, so no further actions or failure diagnosis are inferred.
